name: Game Boy
author: Peanut-GB by Mahyar Koshkouei, MiniGB APU by Alex Baines; NucleoOS
description: Game Boy (DMG) emulator: plays the .gb games you copy to /sdcard/home/roms (homebrew or your own cartridge backups, up to 4 MB), with sound, 3x/4x zoom, four palettes, touch controls and gamepads. Battery saves go next to each game as .sav. Game Boy Color-only games are not supported.

descriptions.en: Game Boy (DMG) emulator: plays the .gb games you copy to /sdcard/home/roms (homebrew or your own cartridge backups, up to 4 MB), with sound, 3x/4x zoom, four palettes, touch controls and gamepads. Battery saves go next to each game as .sav. Game Boy Color-only games are not supported.
descriptions.it: Emulatore Game Boy (DMG): gioca i file .gb che copi in /sdcard/home/roms (homebrew o copie delle tue cartucce, fino a 4 MB), con audio, zoom 3x/4x, quattro palette, comandi touch e gamepad. I salvataggi della batteria finiscono accanto al gioco come .sav. I giochi solo Game Boy Color non sono supportati.
